s0001.literal: Emperor Wuzong, posthumous name Renhui Xuanxiao, taboo name Haishan, was the eldest son of Shunzong Darmabala.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong, posthumous name Renhui Xuanxiao, taboo name Haishan, was the eldest son of Shunzong Darmabala.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.

s0003.literal: He was born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan.
s0003.idiomatic: He was born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan.

s0004.literal: In the third year of Dade under Emperor Temür, Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu commanded troops on the northern frontier but was lax in defense; Khayishan was ordered to replace him in the army.
s0004.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade under Emperor Temür, Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu commanded troops on the northern frontier but was lax in defense; Khayishan was ordered to replace him in the army.

s0005.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year he fought Qaidu's army at Koipelie and defeated it.
s0005.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year he fought Qaidu's army at Koipelie and defeated it.

s0006.literal: In the twelfth month the army reached Aitai Mountain, and the Naiman-tai tribe submitted.
s0006.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the army reached Aitai Mountain, and the Naiman-tai tribe submitted.

s0007.literal: On the new moon of the eighth month of the fifth year he fought Qaidu at Djikeleg; Qaidu's army was routed.
s0007.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month of the fifth year he fought Qaidu at Djikeleg; Qaidu's army was routed.

s0008.literal: Two days later Qaidu gathered all his forces and came; a great battle was fought at Khar Khata; the army suffered a reverse, but Khayishan personally went out into the ranks and fought fiercely, inflicting a great defeat, capturing all their baggage train in full, and bringing out all the princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and other armies.
s0008.idiomatic: Two days later Qaidu gathered all his forces and came; a great battle was fought at Khar Khata; the army suffered a reverse, but Khayishan personally went out into the ranks and fought fiercely, inflicting a great defeat, capturing all their baggage train in full, and bringing out all the princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and other armies.

s0009.literal: The next day they fought again; the army fell back slightly, and Qaidu pressed the advantage; Khayishan commanded the army and fought fiercely, breaking through behind the enemy formation and returning with the whole army intact.
s0009.idiomatic: The next day they fought again; the army fell back slightly, and Qaidu pressed the advantage; Khayishan commanded the army and fought fiercely, breaking through behind the enemy formation and returning with the whole army intact.

s0010.literal: Qaidu departed without achieving his aim and soon died as well.
s0010.idiomatic: Qaidu departed without achieving his aim and soon died as well.

s0011.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted, princely tutor officials were established, and sixty-five thousand households of Ruizhou were assigned as his fief.
s0011.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted, princely tutor officials were established, and 65,000 households of Ruizhou were assigned as his fief.

s0012.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, from the region of Tughusi he crossed Aitai Mountain in pursuit of the rebel prince Orus and captured his wives, children, and baggage train;
s0012.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year, from the region of Tughusi he crossed Aitai Mountain in pursuit of the rebel prince Orus and captured his wives, children, and baggage train;

s0013.literal: the rebel princes Yesun Tu'a and others and the imperial son-in-law Bayan were seized.
s0013.idiomatic: the rebel princes Yesun Tu'a and others and the imperial son-in-law Bayan were seized.

s0014.literal: In the eighth month he reached Yelidishi and received the submission of the surrendered princes Tudum, Mingli Temür, Aruguei, and others.
s0014.idiomatic: In the eighth month he reached Yelidishi and received the submission of the surrendered princes Tudum, Mingli Temür, Aruguei, and others.

s0015.literal: Qaidu's son Chapar fled to Duwa's tribe; all his family members, camps, and tents were captured.
s0015.idiomatic: Qaidu's son Chapar fled to Duwa's tribe; all his family members, camps, and tents were captured.

s0016.literal: He wintered at Aitai Mountain; the surrendered prince Tarkhai rebelled again, was defeated in battle, and the northern frontier was entirely pacified.
s0016.idiomatic: He wintered at Aitai Mountain; the surrendered prince Tarkhai rebelled again, was defeated in battle, and the northern frontier was entirely pacified.

s0017.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, hearing that Emperor Temür had died, in the third month he went from Aitai Mountain to Karakorum.
s0017.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year, hearing that Emperor Temür had died, in the third month he went from Aitai Mountain to Karakorum.

s0018.literal: Princes and meritorious kin all assembled and said that Ananda, Mingli Temür, and others were beguiling the inner palace and secretly harbored divergent designs;
s0018.idiomatic: Princes and meritorious kin all assembled and said that Ananda, Mingli Temür, and others were beguiling the inner palace and secretly harbored divergent designs;

s0019.literal: Prince Yeshili had once communicated with rebel princes and was now also involved in the plot.
s0019.idiomatic: Prince Yeshili had once communicated with rebel princes and was now also involved in the plot.

s0020.literal: After they had submitted and been executed, all together they urged Khayishan to ascend the throne.
s0020.idiomatic: After they had submitted and been executed, all together they urged Khayishan to ascend the throne.

s0021.literal: Khayishan declined, saying: "My mother and my younger brother are in Dadu; wait until all the imperial kin have assembled and then deliberate.
s0021.idiomatic: Khayishan declined, saying, "My mother and my younger brother are in Dadu; wait until all the imperial kin have assembled and then deliberate.

s0022.literal: " Earlier, when Emperor Temür had long been ill, government issued from the inner palace; the Emperor ordered Renzong and the empress dowager to leave the capital and reside at Huaizhou.
s0022.idiomatic: " Earlier, when Emperor Temür had long been ill, government issued from the inner palace; the Emperor ordered Renzong and the empress dowager to leave the capital and reside at Huaizhou.

s0023.literal: At this time Renzong, hearing the death announcement, arrived at the capital with the empress dowager on xinhai day of the second month.
s0023.idiomatic: At this time Renzong, hearing the death announcement, arrived at the capital with the empress dowager on xinhai day of the second month.

s0024.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür had already arrived first on gengwu day of the first month.
s0024.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür had already arrived first on gengwu day of the first month.

s0025.literal: Left chancellor Ahutai, grand councillor Badmashin, former central secretariat grand councillor Bayan, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qielie and Daoxing, and others secretly plotted to install Emperor Temür's empress Boheljen as regent, with Ananda to assist her.
s0025.idiomatic: Left chancellor Ahutai, grand councillor Badmashin, former central secretariat grand councillor Bayan, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qielie and Daoxing, and others secretly plotted to install Emperor Temür's empress Boheljen as regent, with Ananda to assist her.

s0026.literal: Renzong, using Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan's plan, spoke to the empress dowager, saying: "The Taizu and Shizu emperors founded the enterprise amid hardship; now the late emperor has passed away, Deshou has died, all the princes are distant kin, and the Prince of Huaining is in the north — these men secretly harbor divergent designs, and change may come at any moment; if we wait until the Prince of Huaining arrives, I fear disorder of unforeseeable kind; better to strike first.
s0026.idiomatic: Renzong, using right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan's plan, spoke to the empress dowager, saying, "The Taizu and Shizu emperors founded the enterprise amid hardship; now the late emperor has passed away, Deshou has died, all the princes are distant kin, and the Prince of Huaining is in the north — these men secretly harbor divergent designs, and change may come at any moment; if we wait until the Prince of Huaining arrives, I fear disorder of unforeseeable kind; better to strike first.

s0027.literal: " The plan was settled; Ahutai, Qielie, and others were executed, and envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan.
s0027.idiomatic: " The plan was settled; Ahutai, Qielie, and others were executed, and envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan.

s0028.literal: In the fifth month he reached Shangdu.
s0028.idiomatic: In the fifth month he reached Shangdu.

s0029.literal: On yichou day Renzong attended the empress dowager to the assembly; princes of the left and right wings all arrived for deliberation; Empress Boheljen was deposed and sent to reside at Dong'an Prefecture and granted death;
s0029.idiomatic: On yichou day Renzong attended the empress dowager to the assembly; princes of the left and right wings all arrived for deliberation; Empress Boheljen was deposed and sent to reside at Dong'an Prefecture and granted death;

s0030.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür were brought to Shangdu and likewise all granted death.
s0030.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür were brought to Shangdu and likewise all granted death.

s0031.literal: On jiashen day the Emperor took the throne at Shangdu, received the court of princes, civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:
s0031.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor took the throne at Shangdu, received the court of princes, civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:

s0032.literal: Formerly our Taizu Emperor established the realm by martial achievement, and our Shizu Emperor harmonized all within the seas by civil virtue; successive sacred rulers succeeded one another, greatly extending boundless fortune.
s0032.idiomatic: Formerly our Taizu Emperor established the realm by martial achievement, and our Shizu Emperor harmonized all within the seas by civil virtue; successive sacred rulers succeeded one another, greatly extending boundless fortune.

s0033.literal: From the previous reign We have reverently borne Heaven's majesty, governing armies in the north for nearly ten years, repeatedly donning armor and fighting in person to repulse the enemy.
s0033.idiomatic: From the previous reign We have reverently borne Heaven's majesty, governing armies in the north for nearly ten years, repeatedly donning armor and fighting in person to repulse the enemy.

s0034.literal: Just as the frontier princes submitted inward and border affairs were settled, We suddenly heard that the imperial carriage had halted; then imperial-clan princes, meritorious kin, and founding ministers together fixed policy at Karakorum, all holding that We are the direct line of Shizu's great-grandson and the legitimate transmission of Yuzong's branch, and that by merit and virtue We should receive the great treasure.
s0034.idiomatic: Just as the frontier princes submitted inward and border affairs were settled, We suddenly heard that the imperial carriage had halted; then imperial-clan princes, meritorious kin, and founding ministers together fixed policy at Karakorum, all holding that We are the direct line of Shizu's great-grandson and the legitimate transmission of Yuzong's branch, and that by merit and virtue We should receive the great treasure.

s0035.literal: We declined in humility and had no leisure for it, even to the second and third time.
s0035.idiomatic: We declined in humility and had no leisure for it, even to the second and third time.

s0036.literal: Returning to Shangdu, imperial kin and great ministers again petitioned Us.
s0036.idiomatic: Returning to Shangdu, imperial kin and great ministers again petitioned Us.

s0037.literal: Recently treacherous ministers seized the interval and plotted rebellion; relying on the spirits of the ancestors, Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada received command from the empress dowager and reverently executed Heaven's punishment.
s0037.idiomatic: Recently treacherous ministers seized the interval and plotted rebellion; relying on the spirits of the ancestors, Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada received command from the empress dowager and reverently executed Heaven's punishment.

s0038.literal: Once the internal trouble was settled, the sacred vessel could not long stand empty, nor the ancestral temple go without sacrifice; all together they urged Us to ascend, and their sincere intent grew ever firmer.
s0038.idiomatic: Once the internal trouble was settled, the sacred vessel could not long stand empty, nor the ancestral temple go without sacrifice; all together they urged Us to ascend, and their sincere intent grew ever firmer.

s0039.literal: We reluctantly yielded to public sentiment and on the twenty-first day of the fifth month took the imperial throne.
s0039.idiomatic: We reluctantly yielded to public sentiment and on the twenty-first day of the fifth month took the imperial throne.

s0040.literal: The burden is great and the charge heavy, as if treading on deep ice.
s0040.idiomatic: The burden is great and the charge heavy, as if treading on deep ice.

s0041.literal: At the cloud's first rising of Our succession, We should renew beginnings with the people; a general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted.
s0041.idiomatic: At the cloud's first rising of Our succession, We should renew beginnings with the people; a general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted.

s0042.literal: Care for garrison soldiers on campaign and prefectures and circuits with heavy supply burdens; remit corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing for three years; for the remaining routes, remit in proportion to severity.
s0042.idiomatic: Care for garrison soldiers on campaign and prefectures and circuits with heavy supply burdens; remit corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing for three years; for the remaining routes, remit in proportion to severity.

s0043.literal: In the Yunnan bafan and Tian-Yang territories, remit requisition levies for one year.
s0043.idiomatic: In the Yunnan bafan and Tian-Yang territories, remit requisition levies for one year.

s0044.literal: Those with arrears accumulated over years are to be remitted;
s0044.idiomatic: Those with arrears accumulated over years are to be remitted;

s0045.literal: those who fled and now return to their occupations are exempt for three years.
s0045.idiomatic: those who fled and now return to their occupations are exempt for three years.

s0046.literal: In disaster-stricken places, mountain-forest and lake-revenue duties are temporarily suspended, and the poor are permitted to gather resources.
s0046.idiomatic: In disaster-stricken places, mountain-forest and lake-revenue duties are temporarily suspended, and the poor are permitted to gather resources.

s0047.literal: Where relay households are depleted, give them relief.
s0047.idiomatic: Where relay households are depleted, give them relief.

s0048.literal: Passing armies and horses must not disturb the people.
s0048.idiomatic: Passing armies and horses must not disturb the people.

s0049.literal: At ironworks everywhere, private persons are permitted to operate smelting on contract.
s0049.idiomatic: At ironworks everywhere, private persons are permitted to operate smelting on contract.

s0050.literal: Encourage schools, remit corvée duties for Confucian households;
s0050.idiomatic: Encourage schools, remit corvée duties for Confucian households;

s0051.literal: inquire after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary.
s0051.idiomatic: inquire after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary.

s0052.literal: That day Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor, and Our grand empress and original consort were honored as empress dowager.
s0052.idiomatic: That day Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor, and Our grand empress and original consort were honored as empress dowager.

s0053.literal: On dinghai day the Bureau of Transmission was raised to rank 2a; the Ceremonial Phoenix Office was raised to the Jade Inner Music Bureau at rank 2b.
s0053.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Bureau of Transmission was raised to rank 2a; the Ceremonial Phoenix Office was raised to the Jade Inner Music Bureau at rank 2b.

s0054.literal: On renchen day Director of Privy Council Affairs Dorjeqai was made grand preceptor; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made grand guardian and given charge of state and military affairs;
s0054.idiomatic: On renchen day director of privy council affairs Dorjeqai was made grand preceptor; central secretariat right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made grand guardian and given charge of state and military affairs;

s0055.literal: Director of Privy Council Affairs Tarqai was made left chancellor of the central secretariat and given charge of privy council and Bureau of Palace Provisions affairs;
s0055.idiomatic: Director of privy council affairs Tarqai was made left chancellor of the central secretariat and given charge of privy council and Bureau of Palace Provisions affairs;

s0056.literal: Associate director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Chundu, yeke jarquchi Ashabuhua, and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua were all made grand councillors of the central secretariat;
s0056.idiomatic: Associate director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Chundu, yeke jarquchi Ashabuhua, and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua were all made grand councillors of the central secretariat;

s0057.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left associate administrator Liu Zheng was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat;
s0057.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left associate administrator Liu Zheng was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat;

s0058.literal: by remote appointment Central Secretariat left associate administrator Qincha and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Yesun Temür were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat;
s0058.idiomatic: by remote appointment central secretariat left associate administrator Qincha and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Yesun Temür were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat;

s0059.literal: Central Secretariat right vice chancellor and acting regional censor-in-chief Tasibuhua was made censor-in-chief;
s0059.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor and acting regional censor-in-chief Tasibuhua was made censor-in-chief;

s0060.literal: Grand councillor Chundu was made director of privy council affairs.
s0060.idiomatic: Grand councillor Chundu was made director of privy council affairs.

s0061.literal: By special appointment Qitai Puji was made grand councillor of the central secretariat; Yanqing commissioner Cha'erchi was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; associate director of the Karakorum and other places pacification commission Tahai was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Ali was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Toghto was made censor-in-chief.
s0061.idiomatic: By special appointment Qitai Puji was made grand councillor of the central secretariat; Yanqing commissioner Cha'erchi was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; associate director of the Karakorum and other places pacification commission Tahai was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Ali was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Toghto was made censor-in-chief.

s0062.literal: Because the sixty-two relay stations north of Dadu had exhausted relay households, notes were granted to relieve them.
s0062.idiomatic: Because the 62 relay stations north of Dadu had exhausted relay households, notes were granted to relieve them.

s0063.literal: That month the crown prince's wet nurse Lady Li was enfeoffed as Lady of Shouguo, and her husband Yanjianu was enfeoffed as Duke of Shouguo.
s0063.idiomatic: That month the crown prince's wet nurse Lady Li was enfeoffed as Lady of Shouguo, and her husband Yanjianu was enfeoffed as Duke of Shouguo.

s0064.literal: Central secretariat grand councillor Hesari was made grand councillor of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.
s0064.idiomatic: Central secretariat grand councillor Hesari was made grand councillor of the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

s0065.literal: Jianzhou suffered heavy hail; Zhending, Hejian, Shunde, and Baoding and other prefectures suffered locusts.
s0065.idiomatic: Jianzhou suffered heavy hail; Zhending, Hejian, Shunde, and Baoding and other prefectures suffered locusts.

s0066.literal: Sixth month, on the guisi new moon, an edict installed Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.
s0066.idiomatic: Sixth month, on the guisi new moon, an edict installed Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure.

s0067.literal: The Armory Bureau was raised to the Armory Court at rank 2b.
s0067.idiomatic: The Armory Bureau was raised to the Armory Court at rank 2b.

s0068.literal: On jiawu day a traveling palace was built at Wangwuchadu; palace halls were established and the place was made Central Capital.
s0068.idiomatic: On jiawu day a traveling palace was built at Wangwuchadu; palace halls were established and the place was made Central Capital.

s0069.literal: On dingyou day Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan and Left Chancellor Tarqai said: "We have assembled in deliberation with senior ministers of Hanlin, the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and the Grand Sacrifices Office; the Emperor having newly ascended the precious throne, an edict posthumously honors Our late father as emperor; Our late father was the elder brother by the same mother of the late emperor, and the rites for installing the late emperor's spirit tablet in the temple have not yet been performed; it is fitting that the spirit tablets of the two emperors be installed in the temple according to the order of brothers.
s0069.idiomatic: On dingyou day central secretariat right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan and left chancellor Tarqai said, "We have assembled in deliberation with senior ministers of Hanlin, the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and the Grand Sacrifices Office; the Emperor having newly ascended the precious throne, an edict posthumously honors Our late father as emperor; Our late father was the elder brother by the same mother of the late emperor, and the rites for installing the late emperor's spirit tablet in the temple have not yet been performed; it is fitting that the spirit tablets of the two emperors be installed in the temple according to the order of brothers.

s0070.literal: We now propose requesting the posthumous title Zhaosheng Yanxiao Emperor for Our late father, with temple name Shunzong;
s0070.idiomatic: We now propose requesting the posthumous title Zhaosheng Yanxiao Emperor for Our late father, with temple name Shunzong;

s0071.literal: for the late emperor, Qinming Guangxiao Emperor, with temple name Chengzong.
s0071.idiomatic: for the late emperor, Qinming Guangxiao Emperor, with temple name Chengzong.

s0072.literal: The Taizu chamber is placed at the center; Ruizong in the first western chamber, Shizu in the second western chamber, Yuzong in the third western chamber, Shunzong in the first eastern chamber, and Chengzong in the second eastern chamber.
s0072.idiomatic: The Taizu chamber is placed at the center; Ruizong in the first western chamber, Shizu in the second western chamber, Yuzong in the third western chamber, Shunzong in the first eastern chamber, and Chengzong in the second eastern chamber.

s0073.literal: The original consort of the Hongjira clan, Shilin Tegin, should receive the posthumous title Zhenci Jingyi Empress and be installed in Chengzong's temple chamber.
s0073.idiomatic: The original consort of the Hongjira clan, Shilin Tegin, should receive the posthumous title Zhenci Jingyi Empress and be installed in Chengzong's temple chamber.

s0075.literal: " They also said: "Formerly We received an edict ordering Us to deliberate on rewards for princes at court assemblies; We deliberated: when Xianzong and Shizu ascended the throne, rewards were fixed in number; when Chengzong ascended, inheriting Shizu's treasury in abundance, compared with earlier precedent, those granted fifty taels of gold were increased to two hundred fifty taels, and those granted fifty taels of silver to one hundred fifty taels.
s0075.idiomatic: " They also said, "Formerly We received an edict ordering Us to deliberate on rewards for princes at court assemblies; We deliberated: when Xianzong and Shizu ascended the throne, rewards were fixed in number; when Chengzong ascended, inheriting Shizu's treasury in abundance, compared with earlier precedent, those granted 50 taels of gold were increased to 250 taels, and those granted 50 taels of silver to 150 taels.

s0076.literal: " An edict said: "Grant according to the numbers Chengzong bestowed.
s0076.idiomatic: " An edict said, "Grant according to the numbers Chengzong bestowed.

s0077.literal: " On wuxu day Halaqsun Dalaqan said: "Recently at the assembly of princes and imperial sons-in-law at Karakorum, those who had already received grants ought not to receive them again.
s0077.idiomatic: " On wuxu day Halaqsun Dalaqan said, "Recently at the assembly of princes and imperial sons-in-law at Karakorum, those who had already received grants ought not to receive them again.

s0078.literal: " The Emperor said: "At the Karakorum assembly state affairs were still pressing; those already granted shall receive again.
s0078.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "At the Karakorum assembly state affairs were still pressing; those already granted shall receive again.

s0079.literal: " On jihai day Censor-in-Chief Toghto and Hanlin awaiting-edict drafter Sanbaonu said: "Under the old system, crown prince officials were drawn jointly from the secretariat and censorate; We request that Oljei, pacification commissioner of Luolosi, be appointed within the central secretariat.
s0079.idiomatic: " On jihai day censor-in-chief Toghto and Hanlin awaiting-edict drafter Sanbaonu said, "Under the old system, crown prince officials were drawn jointly from the secretariat and censorate; We request that Oljei, pacification commissioner of Luolosi, be appointed within the central secretariat.

s0080.literal: " An edict appointed him right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0080.idiomatic: " An edict appointed him right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0081.literal: At court assembly each agency was permitted to place one man with the crown prince.
s0081.idiomatic: At court assembly each agency was permitted to place one man with the crown prince.

s0082.literal: Because Ma Mousha, commander of the Archery Guard, repeatedly won at wrestling contests, he was by remote appointment made grand councillor.
s0082.idiomatic: Because Ma Mousha, commander of the Archery Guard, repeatedly won at wrestling contests, he was by remote appointment made grand councillor.

s0083.literal: On renyin day Tarqai was additionally made grand guardian, given charge of state and military affairs, and made crown prince grand preceptor.
s0083.idiomatic: On renyin day Tarqai was additionally made grand guardian, given charge of state and military affairs, and made crown prince grand preceptor.

s0084.literal: On guimao day the Crown Prince Household Court was established.
s0084.idiomatic: On guimao day the Crown Prince Household Court was established.

s0085.literal: On jiachen day the privy council requested two thousand five hundred soldiers to repair the Shangdu falconry office and various official buildings; an edict said: "From now on, unless by imperial order, soldiers must not be requisitioned for labor.
s0085.idiomatic: On jiachen day the privy council requested 2,500 soldiers to repair the Shangdu falconry office and various official buildings; an edict said, "From now on, unless by imperial order, soldiers must not be requisitioned for labor.

s0086.literal: " Grand councillor and acting Karakorum and other places pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief Ganlaqar, and Bureau of Transmission commissioner and Armory director Temür Buhua were both made directors of privy council affairs.
s0086.idiomatic: " Grand councillor and acting Karakorum and other places pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief Ganlaqar, and Bureau of Transmission commissioner and Armory director Temür Buhua were both made directors of privy council affairs.

s0087.literal: On yisi day two thousand seven hundred fifty taels of gold, one hundred twenty-nine thousand two hundred taels of silver, ten thousand ingots of notes, and twenty-two thousand two hundred eighty bolts of silks and cloths were presented to the Xingsheng Palace; the crown prince was granted the same.
s0087.idiomatic: On yisi day 2,750 taels of gold, 129,200 taels of silver, 10,000 ingots of notes, and 22,280 bolts of silks and cloths were presented to the Xingsheng Palace; the crown prince was granted the same.

s0088.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "There are fourteen chancellors of the central secretariat and four censor-in-chiefs — numbers the former system did not provide for.
s0088.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "There are 14 chancellors of the central secretariat and 4 censor-in-chiefs — numbers the former system did not provide for.

s0089.literal: " An edict ordered deliberation with senior ministers of Hanlin and the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and a memorial in reply.
s0089.idiomatic: " An edict ordered deliberation with senior ministers of Hanlin and the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and a memorial in reply.

s0090.literal: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the Dipper's ladle stars.
s0090.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the Dipper's ladle stars.

s0091.literal: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Botou and others said: "Biebuhua built a monastery with private funds to pray for the state's blessing.
s0091.idiomatic: Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Botou and others said, "Biebuhua built a monastery with private funds to pray for the state's blessing.

s0092.literal: His father was killed by Prince Ogö, and We request that he be granted Ogö's annual stipend.
s0092.idiomatic: His father was killed by Prince Ogö, and We request that he be granted Ogö's annual stipend.

s0093.literal: " An order granted it to him for five years: four thousand one hundred-odd taels of silver, thirty-one thousand two hundred ninety jin of silk, one hundred taels of gold in woven goods, and seven hundred ten bolts of silk.
s0093.idiomatic: " An order granted it to him for five years: 4,100-odd taels of silver, 31,290 jin of silk, 100 taels of gold in woven goods, and 710 bolts of silk.

s0094.literal: On wushen day by special appointment Master of the Imperial Stud Borlanxi and Chundu were made grand councillors; Qarimuddin, darughachi of the Datong garrison-farming military-civilian general office, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0095.literal: On xinhai day Central Secretariat Grand Councillor Toghto was made grand councillor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat.

s0096.literal: On renzi day the Emperor's younger sister Sanggarjai was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Lu, and her imperial son-in-law Abula was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

s0097.literal: Temür Buhua, Ganlaqar, and others said: "Under the old system the privy council selected and transferred military officers after public deliberation and memorialized the throne.
s0097.idiomatic: Temür Buhua, Ganlaqar, and others said, "Under the old system the privy council selected and transferred military officers after public deliberation and memorialized the throne.

s0098.literal: Recently close attendants have themselves chosen titles and received edicts from within; We fear this will ruin Shizu's fixed system and moreover err in state affairs.
s0098.idiomatic: Recently close attendants have themselves chosen titles and received edicts from within; We fear this will ruin Shizu's fixed system and moreover err in state affairs.

s0099.literal: In Chengzong's time there was once an edict that those who rashly memorialized on privy council affairs were permitted to state their case again before this court.

s0100.literal: We hold that from now on in appointing men, Shizu and Chengzong's established statutes should be uniformly followed.
